scope: Read-only audit of application-owned connector orchestration, not Temporal/OpenFGA internals. No source or Git mutations.

findings.trigger: Begin commits and provider/cleanup may occur, then response loss or process restart before settlement; old lease expires with attempt below100.
findings.actual: reserve overwrites attempted reservation as reserved and captured_receipt=NULL; fresh adapter installs reservation with no captured proof. Worker calls GetWorkflow/prepare which require fresh live authorization. Revoked work pauses instead of completing exact prior cleanup.
findings.required: A native durable recovery operation must validate the original attempted receipt and immutable source before rotating lease, preserving original capture lineage. Recovery authority must be explicitly compensation-only, distinct from forward provider preparation. Old expired lease and any other repository cannot adopt a live lease.
findings.risk: Do not simply return captured_receipt after reserve: its signed reference includes old owner/token/expiry, so correctly fails existing captured guards. Do not mint normal provider-kind receipt for cleanup-only recovery because CompleteOAuth and forward metadata read might then broaden authority.

findings.trigger: consume_callback commits, then response is lost or process dies before exact verifier removal; OAuth is consuming and callback has short expiry.
findings.actual: Only callback token digest persists; plaintext permit is process-local. Callback cannot be re-consumed. callback_step expires. PKCE reserve excludes all consuming attempts, even expired callback. Authorize recovery requires fresh live authority, so revocation blocks recovery and leaves cleanup pending.
findings.required: Bridge expired authenticated callback into phase-specific durable compensation for the exact captured PKCE/authorize effects under native SQL scope/source checks, with old callback lease exclusion and no verifier read/exchange. Preserve unknown external outcomes honestly.

findings.trigger: Authorization succeeded; cleanup_pending persisted; process restarts or cleanup retries after grant revocation.
findings.actual: Before testing cleanup_pending, reconcileLease calls workflows.GetWorkflow. Native workflow requires fresh before_metadata authority. Then cleanup branch calls prepare, which requires fresh BeforeProvider, rather than captured compensation.
findings.required: Recovery cleanup must use an immutable captured provider binding/configuration reference with narrowly scoped read if necessary; current arbitrary workflow metadata must remain forbidden after revoke. Captured cleanup operations may Discard/Delete only exact effect/reference and never start exchange, RecoverAuthorization, or new Revoke.

proposed_batch.title: Durable phase-aware connector recovery and exact compensation
sql: Separate reserved forward leases from compensation recovery leases/purpose.

Under global lane lock and organization->effect->reservation lock order, validate stored original HMAC plus exact full scope, integration, effect, intent/context, attempt kind and original expiry before rotating an expired owned lease.
Persist immutable receipt lineage and phase/provider binding; retain attempt budget and original audit semantics. Do not change original immutable SQL/provenance.

Add callback expiry bridge limited by durable phase: consumed/secret/rejection secret permit Delete only; provider phase remains unknown outcome, never invent success; completed/cleanup permits exact Discard(false) and cleanup settlement.
At attempt100 preserve quarantine path and require authentic receipt.
adapter_worker: Strictly decode bounded recovery mode/proof from native SQL, never caller flags.
Hydrate only newly claimed expired lease, never adopt arbitrary live lease.
Dispatch recovery cleanup before live metadata path; fresh provider operations continue full current authority.
Ensure ambiguous SQL commit or external effect response cannot erase the only durable compensation proof.

grouped_acceptance_cases: Real signed enqueue -> Begin -> restart a new repository after natural minimum lease expiry -> revoke -> exact Delete/Discard succeeds and audit settles; no secret Consume or provider forward calls.
Crash after callback consume commit before local permit installation -> natural expiry -> revoke -> exact PKCE Delete through recovery, attempted callback replay denied.
External cleanup succeeds but SQL response lost -> restart/retry idempotently -> one terminal application state with preserved audit; no fabricated provider proof.
Cleanup_pending after CompleteOAuth -> revoke membership and reconcile projection -> restart -> exact Discard(false) allowed, arbitrary workflow read/provider exchange denied.

Forged, wrong tenant/workspace/environment, integration/effect/reference, wrong principal/key, changed intent/context, live-lease adoption, old lease replay and cross-operation recovery all denied with zero external calls.
Final100 genuine captured attempt -> natural expiry -> authentic quarantine/audit and no further external attempt.
Full deployed provider/Stytch browser flows remain separately required; local fixtures cannot promote original task availability.
existing_coverage_limit: Current five lifecycle subcases verify genuine enqueues, controlled single-writer cutover, live-lease adoption denial, and same-process captured compensation. They do not verify durable repository restart/expired callback recovery.
